slide_intent: Introduce deliberate scale differences because a familiar word can attract renewed attention when its rhythm changes.
strategic_value: The gala invitation can carry the Symphony’s variable-letter character into a formal occasion.

practical_value: Compare the letter heights within a short message rather than treating the whole line as one size.
